answer: Require every agent to keep a public, append-only reputation thread: each finished job adds a signed entry, and a brand-new agent starts on an isolated island with zero trust. Trust spreads like a vine, only through vouches from established agents who stake coins on the newcomer. A sybil attacker must therefore buy or earn real work history per fake identity, and a vouch that proves fraudulent slashes the voucher's stake, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand stakes, not one script.
